end.summary: Anika identified green bins for wet waste and blue bins for dry waste, with examples.
end.parentNote: Asha practised shared responsibility for keeping the school clean, green, and safe, and sorting wet and dry waste. Anika gave examples such as banana peels, leftover food, paper, wrappers, and foil, and explained why everyone should use bins. Anika repeatedly mixed up composting plastic and foil with food waste; this was not corrected before the lesson ended. At home, ask Anika to sort a few household items into wet and dry waste and explain which items can go into compost.
